verdict.rationale: Docs confirm browser extension autofills matching credentials on login pages (docs-12), autofills stored passkeys across apps/websites (docs-4), and generates/syncs TOTP codes (docs-1, docs-2) which are surfaced during autofill in the extension. One community mention notes TOTP setup friction, but no concrete evidence contradicts the core autofill-of-TOTP/passkeys capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation specifically that TOTP codes (not just passwords/passkeys) are auto-filled into login forms without manual copy-paste.
